user.title: Set up Audioengine speakers
user.description: Controls Audioengine A5+ powered speakers through an infrared emitter such as a Broadlink RM. State is assumed: Sleep and Mute are toggles on the remote and the speakers cannot report back.

data_description.infrared_entity_id: The infrared emitter entity that points at the left (powered) speaker.
data_description.infrared_receiver_entity_id: Optional. If your blaster can receive, the entity keeps in sync when the physical remote is used.

abort.no_infrared_entities: No infrared emitter found. Set up a device that provides one (for example Broadlink) first.
